name: Hold the Line, Hold Your Fire

description.value:
Effect a chosen ally either braces (+2 circumstance to AC until your next turn) or holds for a bigger response (their next Strike against a target that attacks them this round deals an extra 2d6 damage) — their choice, made when you give the order

Give an ally the choice: brace now, or hit harder in a moment.

cinderfall.incomplete: A chosen ally either braces (+2 AC until next turn) or holds for a bigger response (+2d6 on their next Strike vs. their attacker), their choice. No companion effect exists for this slug, and unlike the mass action-grant precedent (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/class/commander/*.json) this is a static numeric ally buff with a player-choice branch -- no matching real precedent found for that combination.
